import Solidity.Frontend.Testing

open Solidity Solidity.Frontend Lean Elab Command Meta

namespace ReplayCosts

def leaves {C : Contract} {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) :
    Option (List (Seq.SLeaf C)) := some [⟨_, H, φ⟩]

def quoted {C : Contract} (c : Expr) (np : Option Nat) {Γ : Ctx}
    (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) : Option (List Expr) :=
  some [Seq.SLeaf.quote c np H φ]

-- Keep branch refutation identical; disable only terminal leaf checks.
def residue {C : Contract} {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) :=
  (Seq.run .all leaves Seq.refuteLanded 128 H φ 128).map (·.1)

def quoteResidue {C : Contract} (c : Expr) (np : Option Nat) {Γ : Ctx}
    (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) :=
  (Seq.run .all (quoted c np) Seq.refuteLanded 128 H φ 128).map (·.1)

private def certify (ty lhs rhs : Expr) : MetaM Float := do
  let equality := mkApp3 (mkConst ``Eq [1]) ty lhs rhs
  let proof := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Eq.refl [1]) ty rhs
  let start ← IO.monoNanosNow
  let name ← withOptions (Elab.async.set · false) <| mkAuxLemma [] equality proof (cache := false)
  let checked := mkConst name
  let elapsed := ((← IO.monoNanosNow)-start).toFloat/1000000
  let some name := checked.constName? | throwError "expected checked theorem"
  unless ← usesOnlyStandardAxioms name do throwError "nonstandard axiom"
  return elapsed

def stripped {C : Contract} (φ : Decide.LFml C) : Decide.LFml C :=
  φ.dropPrem (fun _ => true)

def trivial {C : Contract} (φ : Decide.LFml C) : Decide.LFml C :=
  φ.dropPrem fun P => match P with
    | @Decide.LFml.eq _ .bool a b => a.isTT && b.isTT
    | _ => false

elab "#split_replay " n:ident " to " output:str : command => do
  let ns := n.getId
  let mut results : Array Json := #[]
  for r in ← reportRows ns do
    unless r.tag == .specified do continue
    let result ← liftTermElabM <| withCurrHeartbeats do
      let C := mkConst ns
      let formula ← testFormula ns r
      let phi ← Symex.evaluable formula
      let H := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Hyps.nil) C (ctxE [])
      let np ← Seq.paramCount H phi
      let qTy := mkApp (mkConst ``Option [0]) (mkApp (mkConst ``List [0]) (mkConst ``Expr))
      let some ls ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr (Option (List Expr)) qTy
        (mkAppN (mkConst ``quoteResidue) #[C,quoteConstName ns,toExpr np,ctxE [],H,phi])
        | throwError "walk failed"
      let leafTy := mkApp (mkConst ``Seq.SLeaf) C
      let listTy := mkApp (mkConst ``List [0]) leafTy
      let resTy := mkApp (mkConst ``Option [0]) listTy
      let rhs := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Option.some [0]) listTy (← mkListLit leafTy ls)
      let walkMs ← certify resTy (mkAppN (mkConst ``residue) #[C,ctxE [],H,formula]) rhs
      let mut checks : Array Json := #[]
      for l in ls do
        let l ← whnf l
        let args := l.getAppArgs
        let Γ := args[2]!
        let pair ← whnf args[3]!
        let parts := pair.getAppArgs
        let lhs := mkAppN (mkConst ``Seq.leafCheckS) #[C,Γ,parts[2]!,parts[3]!]
        let ty := mkApp (mkConst ``Option [0]) (mkConst ``Bool)
        let value ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr (Option Bool) ty lhs
        let ms ← certify ty lhs (toExpr value)
        let wrapped ← mkAppM ``Hyps.wrap #[parts[2]!, parts[3]!]
        let lower ← mkAppM ``Fml.toLS #[toExpr true, mkApp (mkConst ``Decide.SymS.init) C, wrapped]
        let quoted ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr (Option (Expr × String))
          (mkApp (mkConst ``Option [0]) (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Prod [0,0]) (mkConst ``Expr) (mkConst ``String)))
          (mkApp3 (mkConst ``Decide.LFml.quoteOpt) C (quoteConstName ns) lower)
        let mut stages : Array (String × Json) := #[]
        if let some (reduced, printed) := quoted then
          let lty := mkApp (mkConst ``Decide.LFml) C
          let loweredMs ← certify (mkApp (mkConst ``Option [0]) lty) lower
            (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Option.some [0]) lty reduced)
          let decision ← mkAppM ``Decide.LFml.decideLift #[reduced]
          let decided ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr Bool (mkConst ``Bool) decision
          let decidedMs ← certify (mkConst ``Bool) decision (toExpr decided)
          stages := #[("loweringKernelMs",toJson loweredMs),("decisionKernelMs",toJson decidedMs),
            ("decisionResult",toJson decided),("reduced",toJson printed)]
          for (label, pass) in [("stripped", ``stripped), ("sliced", ``Decide.LFml.slice), ("trivial", ``trivial)] do
            let transformed := mkApp2 (mkConst pass) C reduced
            let some (candidate, _) ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr (Option (Expr × String))
              (mkApp (mkConst ``Option [0]) (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Prod [0,0]) (mkConst ``Expr) (mkConst ``String)))
              (mkApp3 (mkConst ``Decide.LFml.quoteOpt) C (quoteConstName ns)
                (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Option.some [0]) lty transformed)) | throwError "quote failed"
            let passMs ← certify lty transformed candidate
            let check ← mkAppM ``Decide.LFml.decideLift #[candidate]
            let passed ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr Bool (mkConst ``Bool) check
            let checkMs ← certify (mkConst ``Bool) check (toExpr passed)
            stages := stages ++ #[(label ++ "PassKernelMs",toJson passMs),
              (label ++ "DecisionKernelMs",toJson checkMs),(label ++ "Result",toJson passed)]
        checks := checks.push (Json.mkObj ([("result",toJson value),("kernelMs",toJson ms)] ++ stages.toList))
      return Json.mkObj [("function",toJson r.name),("walkAndRefutationKernelMs",toJson walkMs),
        ("leafChecks",toJson checks),("status",toJson "checked-diagnostic-components")]
    results := results.push result
    IO.eprintln ("REPLAY_SPLIT " ++ result.compress)
  IO.FS.writeFile output.getString (toJson results).pretty

end ReplayCosts

import Solidity.Frontend.Testing

namespace Solidity.Frontend.SlicedCertificate
open Solidity Decide
variable {C : Contract}

def check (ψ : Fml C []) : Option Bool :=
  (ψ.toLS true SymS.init).map fun l => l.boundsOk && l.slice.decideLift

theorem check_valid {ψ : Fml C []} (h : check ψ = some true) : Fml.Valid ψ := by
  simp only [check, Option.map_eq_some_iff, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
  obtain ⟨l, hl, _, hc⟩ := h
  exact Fml.Valid.of_toLS hl (fun g ν => LFml.slice_holds (LFml.decideLift_valid hc g ν))

def leaf {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) : Option (List (Seq.SLeaf C)) :=
  if (H.wrap φ).modalFree then
    match check (H.wrap φ) with
    | some true => some []
    | _ => Seq.leafS H φ
  else Seq.leafS H φ

theorem leaf_sound {R : RuleSet} {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ)
    (ls : List (Seq.SLeaf C)) (h : leaf H φ = some ls)
    (hl : ∀ l ∈ ls, Proves C R [] l.2.1 l.2.2) : Proves C R [] H φ := by
  unfold leaf at h
  split at h
  · split at h
    · exact Proves.closeHolds (check_valid ‹_›) ‹_›
    · exact Seq.leafS_sound H φ ls h hl
  · exact Seq.leafS_sound H φ ls h hl

def residue (steps : Nat) (R : RuleSet) {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) :=
  (Seq.run R leaf Seq.refuteLanded steps H φ steps).map (·.1)

theorem sound (steps : Nat) {R : RuleSet} {Γ : Ctx} {H : Hyps C [] Γ} {φ : Fml C Γ}
    {ls : List (Seq.SLeaf C)} (h : residue steps R H φ = some ls)
    (hl : ∀ l ∈ ls, Proves C R [] l.2.1 l.2.2) : Proves C R [] H φ := by
  obtain ⟨⟨ls', b'⟩, hr, he⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
  cases he
  exact Seq.run_sound (P := fun l : Seq.SLeaf C => Proves C R [] l.2.1 l.2.2)
    leaf_sound (fun {_} H c h {_ _} live => Seq.refuteLanded_sound H c h live)
    _ H φ _ _ _ hr hl

def openLeaf {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) : Option (List (Seq.SLeaf C)) :=
  some [⟨_, H, φ⟩]

theorem openLeaf_sound {R : RuleSet} {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ)
    (ls : List (Seq.SLeaf C)) (h : openLeaf H φ = some ls)
    (hl : ∀ l ∈ ls, Proves C R [] l.2.1 l.2.2) : Proves C R [] H φ := by
  cases h
  exact hl ⟨_, H, φ⟩ (List.mem_singleton_self _)

def openResidue (steps : Nat) (R : RuleSet) {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) :=
  (Seq.run R openLeaf Seq.refuteLanded steps H φ steps).map (·.1)

theorem openSound (steps : Nat) {R : RuleSet} {Γ : Ctx} {H : Hyps C [] Γ} {φ : Fml C Γ}
    {ls : List (Seq.SLeaf C)} (h : openResidue steps R H φ = some ls)
    (hl : ∀ l ∈ ls, Proves C R [] l.2.1 l.2.2) : Proves C R [] H φ := by
  obtain ⟨⟨ls', b'⟩, hr, he⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
  cases he
  exact Seq.run_sound (P := fun l : Seq.SLeaf C => Proves C R [] l.2.1 l.2.2)
    openLeaf_sound (fun {_} H c h {_ _} live => Seq.refuteLanded_sound H c h live)
    _ H φ _ _ _ hr hl

theorem closedOfStages {R : RuleSet} {Γ : Ctx} {H : Hyps C [] Γ} {φ : Fml C Γ}
    {l s : LFml C} (hm : (H.wrap φ).modalFree = true)
    (hl : (H.wrap φ).toLS true SymS.init = some l) (hs : l.slice = s)
    (hc : s.decideLift = true) : Proves C R [] H φ := by
  have hv : l.slice.Valid := hs.symm ▸ LFml.decideLift_valid hc
  exact Proves.closeHolds (Fml.Valid.of_toLS hl (fun g ν => LFml.slice_holds (hv g ν))) hm

def openQuoteLeaf (c : Lean.Expr) (np : Option Nat) {Γ : Ctx}
    (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) : Option (List Lean.Expr) :=
  some [Seq.SLeaf.quote c np H φ]

def openQuoteResidue (steps : Nat) (R : RuleSet) (c : Lean.Expr) (np : Option Nat)
    {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) :=
  (Seq.run R (openQuoteLeaf c np) Seq.refuteLanded steps H φ steps).map (·.1)

def quoteLeaf (c : Lean.Expr) (np : Option Nat) {Γ : Ctx}
    (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) : Option (List Lean.Expr) :=
  if (H.wrap φ).modalFree then
    match check (H.wrap φ) with
    | some true => some []
    | _ => Seq.leafQuoteS c np H φ
  else Seq.leafQuoteS c np H φ

def quoteResidue (steps : Nat) (R : RuleSet) (c : Lean.Expr) (np : Option Nat)
    {Γ : Ctx} (H : Hyps C [] Γ) (φ : Fml C Γ) :=
  (Seq.run R (quoteLeaf c np) Seq.refuteLanded steps H φ steps).map (·.1)

end Solidity.Frontend.SlicedCertificate

open Solidity Solidity.Frontend Solidity.Frontend.SlicedCertificate Lean Elab Command Meta

private def checkedEq (lhs rhs : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Float) := do
  let type ← mkEq lhs rhs
  let proof ← mkEqRefl rhs
  let t ← IO.monoNanosNow
  let name ← withOptions (Elab.async.set · false) <| mkAuxLemma [] type proof (cache := false)
  let elapsed := ((← IO.monoNanosNow)-t).toFloat/1000000
  unless ← usesOnlyStandardAxioms name do throwError "nonstandard certificate"
  return (mkConst name, elapsed)

private def quoteLower (C ns lower : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let some (l, _) ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr (Option (Expr × String))
    (mkApp (mkConst ``Option [0]) (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Prod [0,0]) (mkConst ``Expr) (mkConst ``String)))
    (mkApp3 (mkConst ``Decide.LFml.quoteOpt) C ns lower) | throwError "outside lowering fragment"
  return ShareCommon.shareCommon l

elab "#staged_certificate " n:ident " to " output:str : command => do
  let ns := n.getId
  let mut results : Array Json := #[]
  for r in ← reportRows ns do
    unless r.tag == .specified do continue
    let result ← liftTermElabM <| withCurrHeartbeats do
      let start ← IO.monoNanosNow
      let C := mkConst ns
      let R := mkConst ``RuleSet.all
      let formula ← testFormula ns r
      let phi ← Symex.evaluable formula
      let H := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Hyps.nil) C (ctxE [])
      let np ← Seq.paramCount H phi
      let qTy := mkApp (mkConst ``Option [0]) (mkApp (mkConst ``List [0]) (mkConst ``Expr))
      let some leaves ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr (Option (List Expr)) qTy
        (mkAppN (mkConst ``openQuoteResidue)
          #[C,toExpr (128:Nat),R,quoteConstName ns,toExpr np,ctxE [],H,phi])
        | throwError "walk failed"
      let leafTy := mkApp (mkConst ``Seq.SLeaf) C
      let listTy := mkApp (mkConst ``List [0]) leafTy
      let ls ← mkListLit leafTy leaves
      let (walkProof, walkMs) ← checkedEq
        (mkAppN (mkConst ``openResidue) #[C,toExpr (128:Nat),R,ctxE [],H,formula])
        (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Option.some [0]) listTy ls)
      let lty := mkApp (mkConst ``Decide.LFml) C
      let mut rows : Array Json := #[]
      let mut proofs : Array (Expr × Expr) := #[]
      let mut passed := true
      for leaf in leaves do
        let args := leaf.getAppArgs
        let Γ := args[2]!
        let pair := args[3]!.getAppArgs
        let h := pair[2]!
        let f := pair[3]!
        let wrapped ← mkAppM ``Hyps.wrap #[h,f]
        let modalFree ← mkAppM ``Fml.modalFree #[wrapped]
        let (hm, modalMs) ← checkedEq modalFree (toExpr true)
        let lower ← mkAppM ``Fml.toLS #[toExpr true,mkApp (mkConst ``Decide.SymS.init) C,wrapped]
        let l ← quoteLower C (quoteConstName ns) lower
        let (hl, lowerMs) ← checkedEq lower (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Option.some [0]) lty l)
        let slice := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Decide.LFml.slice) C l
        let sliced ← quoteLower C (quoteConstName ns) (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Option.some [0]) lty slice)
        let (hs, sliceMs) ← checkedEq slice sliced
        let decision ← mkAppM ``Decide.LFml.decideLift #[sliced]
        let decided ← unsafe Meta.evalExpr Bool (mkConst ``Bool) decision
        let (hc, decisionMs) ← checkedEq decision (toExpr decided)
        if decided then
          let proof := mkAppN (mkConst ``closedOfStages) #[C,R,Γ,h,f,l,sliced,hm,hl,hs,hc]
          proofs := proofs.push (leaf,proof)
        else passed := false
        rows := rows.push (Json.mkObj [("modalKernelMs",toJson modalMs),("lowerKernelMs",toJson lowerMs),
          ("sliceKernelMs",toJson sliceMs),("decisionKernelMs",toJson decisionMs),("result",toJson decided)])
      let mut finalMs := 0.0
      if passed then
        let mut hl := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Seq.SLeaf.nil) C R
        let mut tail := mkApp (mkConst ``List.nil [0]) leafTy
        for (leaf,proof) in proofs.reverse do
          let args := leaf.getAppArgs
          let Γ := args[2]!
          let pair := args[3]!.getAppArgs
          let h := pair[2]!
          let f := pair[3]!
          hl := mkAppN (mkConst ``Seq.SLeaf.cons) #[C,R,Γ,h,f,tail,proof,hl]
          tail := mkAppN (mkConst ``List.cons [0]) #[leafTy,leaf,tail]
        let derivation := mkAppN (mkConst ``openSound) #[C,toExpr (128:Nat),R,ctxE [],H,formula,ls,walkProof,hl]
        let proof := mkAppN (mkConst ``Proves.fmlValid) #[C,R,formula,derivation]
        let name := ns ++ `stagedValid
        let t ← IO.monoNanosNow
        withOptions (Elab.async.set · false) <| addDecl (.thmDecl {
          name, levelParams := [], type := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Fml.Valid) C formula, value := proof })
        finalMs := ((← IO.monoNanosNow)-t).toFloat/1000000
        unless ← usesOnlyStandardAxioms name do throwError "nonstandard final proof"
      return Json.mkObj [("function",toJson r.name),("walkKernelMs",toJson walkMs),
        ("leafChecks",toJson rows),("finalKernelMs",toJson finalMs),("status",toJson (if passed then "proved" else "pending")),
        ("totalMs",toJson (((← IO.monoNanosNow)-start).toFloat/1000000))]
    results := results.push result
    IO.eprintln ("STAGED_CERTIFICATE " ++ result.compress)
  IO.FS.writeFile output.getString (toJson results).pretty
